summary: Round 1 had no findings, so nothing needed fixing. Commit 1cbe8ad changes only tests/stats/trends.test.ts, adding unit cases for bb100Value: a negative half-way value, a -0 check, and the safe-LCM switch point. It also changes doit/ bookkeeping files. Production code (src/) is unchanged and the round-1 analysis still holds: tampered IndexedDB bigBet values are rejected by parseHandRecord, gcd is iterative, the LCM is capped at MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and falls back to a finite float sum, and the result is never NaN or Infinity. The new tests use static fixtures, with no I/O, secrets, dependencies or randomness. The working tree is clean, so there are no untracked files to review. No new security issue.
